{{Top|leg}}
'''Tram-eights''' were components used aboard [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes. They could also be used to replace the string-guard cables linking the [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] to the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]], resulting in greater power, speed and acceleration.
